firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.
This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;
each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for king Solomon in Yahweh’s house:
the pots; the shovels; and the basins: even all these vessels, which Hiram made for king Solomon, in Yahweh’s house, were of burnished bronze.

the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

definitions.full: H4219. mizraq מִזְרָק noun masculine Num 7:84 bowl, bason (properly vessel for throwing or tossing a liquid); ׳מ 7:13 13 t., plural מִזְרָקִים Zech 14:20 , construct מִזְרְקֵי Num 7:84 2 t., מִזְרָקוֺת Neh 7:70 9 t., מִזְרָקֹת Exod 38:3 2 t., suffix מִזְרְקֹתָיו 27:3 ; — 1 bowl for wine Amos 6:6 . 2 elsewhere for use in ritual of sacrifice: a. for use at altar Exod 27:3 ; 38:3 ; Num 4:14 (all P), 1Kin 7:40 , 45 ; Jer 52:18 ; Zech 9:15 ; 14:20 . b. given by the princes full of flour mingled with oil for a מנחה Num 7:13 , 19 , 25 , 31 , 37 , 43 , 49 , 55 , 61 , 67 , 73, 79, 84, 85 (P). c. golden basons for use in the temple 1Kin 7:50 ; 2Kin 12:14 ; 25:15 ; 1Chr 28:17 ; 2Chr 4:8 , 11 , 22 ; Jer 52:19 . d. golden basons for the second temple Neh 7:70 .
